neural_policy: Preserve original checkpoint, PCA, and test archive. No retraining or test-based selection.
bayes_sources: Same first realization of the first two sorted validation source IDs as original pilot
sampler: Four independent chains; fixed mixture of pilot-fitted multivariate Student-t independence MH with exact Hastings correction and symmetric local Gaussian MH. Same full 9D posterior, PA represented on one full-period branch.
convergence: All four physical targets, all five nuisance coordinates, and PA sine/cosine: rank/folded split Rhat <1.01, bulk ESS >=400 and tail ESS >=400. Otherwise comparison is inconclusive.
new_data: None. No challenge training or new blind data generation.
